# GraphMaker Suite — AI Integration Guide

> Publication-ready mathematical graphing, statistics, and discrete diagram generator (SVG & 300-DPI PNG) hosted statically on GitHub Pages.
> Live site: https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/
> Repository: https://github.com/Thebubble333/GraphMaker02

## 1. Rendering Files Without a Browser (npx CLI — Zero Browser, Pure WebAssembly)

GraphMaker Suite ships a prebuilt, zero-browser, pure-WebAssembly `npx` command-line renderer (`@resvg/resvg-wasm` + bundled Liberation fonts, zero native binaries to compile). Run it directly from GitHub with `npx -y` to render 300-DPI PNGs or MS-Word-safe SVGs right inside your workspace, inspect them, fix any issues, and hand the finished files to the user:

```bash
# Render a 300-DPI PNG directly from GitHub (non-interactive, works immediately):
npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02 --tool function-grapher --config payload.json --out graph.png --dpi 300

# Render an MS-Word-safe SVG (format is auto-inferred from --out extension):
npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02 --tool function-grapher --config payload.json --out graph.svg

# Pipe JSON from stdin:
cat payload.json | npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02 --tool function-grapher --out graph.png --dpi 300

# Generate an editable GitHub Pages deep link:
npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02 --tool function-grapher --config payload.json --format url

# List all 18 supported tool slugs:
npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02 --list
```

- Accepts the exact same JSON payload as the deep-link URLs (via `--config <file-or-json>`, positional `<file.json>`, or `stdin`).
- Validates strictly against the tool schema by default: prints clear warnings/errors to `stderr` and exits with code `2` on unknown fields, invalid integral IDs, or math syntax errors so you can self-correct.
- **PNG font vs. SVG master copy**: Headless PNGs are rasterized with bundled **Liberation Serif** (metric-compatible open-source substitute for Times New Roman) and **Liberation Sans**, so PNGs work identically on Linux sandboxes without system fonts. The **SVG** specifies `Times New Roman` and is the master copy for Microsoft Word / print on Windows and macOS.
- **`npx github:` cache & casing note**: `npx` caches GitHub packages by exact repository casing (`Thebubble333/GraphMaker02` vs `thebubble333/GraphMaker02`). Always use the canonical casing `npx -y github:Thebubble333/GraphMaker02`, and re-run with `-y` (or `--prefer-online` / clearing the npx cache if needed) after a new push to pick up CLI updates.

## 2. Deep-Link URL Format (Works in Any Web AI Without Code Execution)

Construct a clickable URL that opens any tool pre-populated with your JSON configuration:

https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/?tool=<SLUG>&config=<URL_ENCODED_JSON>

- `tool`: one of the 18 slugs listed below (e.g. `function-grapher`, `inequality-grapher`, `box-plots`).
- `config`: URL-encoded JSON matching the strict per-tool schema at `ai/<SLUG>.json` (or `b64:<base64url-json>` for large payloads).
- Validation feedback: If a generated link contains unknown fields, broken integral IDs, or unparseable math syntax, the page displays an on-screen diagnostic banner with a "Copy report for AI" button so the user can paste the exact error back to you.

## 3. Expression Syntax & Label Gotchas (`function-grapher` & `inequality-grapher`)

- Engine: `mathjs` with GraphMaker preprocessing.
- Implied multiplication: `2x`, `3(x+1)`, `2sin(x)` all work. Explicit `*` (e.g. `2*x`, `x*sin(x)`) is safest when ambiguous.
- Leading `y =` is optional (`"x^2 - 4"` and `"y = x^2 - 4"` both work).
- Constants: `pi` (or `π`), `e`.
- Operators: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `^` (power), `|x|` (auto-converted to `abs(x)`).
- Functions:
  - Roots & absolute value: `sqrt(x)`, `cbrt(x)`, `nthRoot(x, n)`, `abs(x)`
  - Logs & exponentials: `ln(x)` and `log(x)` are BOTH natural log (base e); use `log10(x)` or `log(x, 10)` for base-10; `exp(x)` or `e^x`.
  - Trig: `sin(x)`, `cos(x)`, `tan(x)`, `sec(x)`, `csc(x)` (or `cosec(x)`), `cot(x)`.
  - Inverse trig: `asin(x)`/`arcsin(x)`, `acos(x)`/`arccos(x)`, `atan(x)`/`arctan(x)`.
- Bounds (`integrals[].start`, `integrals[].end`, `functions[].domain`): accept plain numbers OR mathjs expressions as strings (e.g. `-2`, `"0"`, `"-pi/2"`, `"pi"`, `"sqrt(2)"`).
- Function IDs for integrals: Give each function an explicit `"id"` (e.g. `"f1"`, `"f2"`) and reference those IDs in `integrals[].functionId1` / `integrals[].functionId2`. If `"id"` is omitted on functions, GraphMaker auto-assigns 1-based string IDs `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, ... in array order.
- **Label & LaTeX gotchas**:
  - `\text{...}`, `\ln`, and `\mathrm{...}` are **not supported** by the custom math layout engine. Use plain `ln(x)` instead of `\ln(x)`, and `~` for spaces inside `$...$` math segments.
  - **Upright words vs. math mode**: Both axis titles (`config.axisLabels`) and point labels (`points[].label`) support Mixed Mode — plain prose words like `"tangent"`, `"normal"`, or `"Local maximum"` render upright, and you can mix upright text with math via `$...$` (e.g. `"Tangent: $y = 2x - 1$"`, `"Time ($t$)"`). Raw math/coordinate labels without words (e.g. `"(-2, 0)"`, `"$(-2, 0)$"`, `"x^2"`) render in math mode.
  - **Point label placement**: `points[].label` always renders centered directly above `(x, y)` and does not accept a custom offset. To place a free-floating label anywhere on the graph, add a point with `"size": 0` and `"label": "..."` at the desired coordinates.
  - **Origin "0" label**: `autoZeroLabel` is applied automatically in both browser and CLI (hiding `0` when the x-axis crosses strictly inside `yRange`, showing it when `yMin >= 0` or `yMax <= 0`). Override explicitly with `config.showZeroLabel`, `config.originLabelContent` (`"auto"`, `"0"`, `"O"`), and `config.originLabelOffset` (`{ "x": 0, "y": 0 }`).
  - **Axis labels & exact cm sizing**: The CLI automatically expands the SVG `viewBox` around `arrow-end` axis labels (`$x$`, `$y$`) if needed and scales both SVG `width`/`height` (cm) and PNG pixel dimensions proportionally so Word inserts the exact physical grid scale with zero distortion. Fine-tune label positions with `offsetXAxisLabelX/Y` and `offsetYAxisLabelX/Y`.
  - **Avoiding tick-label overlaps**: If a plotted point or tangent line crosses an axis tick number, adjust `config.majorStep`, `config.offsetXAxisNumY`, or `config.offsetYAxisNumX` to keep labels clean.

## 4. Complete Area-Between-Curves Example (`function-grapher`)

Shading the area enclosed between $y = 4 - x^2$ and $y = x + 2$ from $x = -2$ to $x = 1$:

```json
{
  "functions": [
    {
      "id": "f1",
      "expression": "4 - x^2",
      "color": "#000000"
    },
    {
      "id": "f2",
      "expression": "x + 2",
      "color": "#2563eb"
    }
  ],
  "integrals": [
    {
      "functionId1": "f1",
      "functionId2": "f2",
      "start": "-2",
      "end": "1",
      "color": "#3b82f6",
      "opacity": 0.28
    }
  ],
  "points": [
    {
      "x": -2,
      "y": 0,
      "label": "$(-2, 0)$"
    },
    {
      "x": 1,
      "y": 3,
      "label": "$(1, 3)$"
    }
  ],
  "config": {
    "xRange": [
      -3,
      3
    ],
    "yRange": [
      -1,
      5
    ],
    "majorStep": [
      1,
      1
    ],
    "axisLabels": [
      "$x$",
      "$y$"
    ]
  }
}
```

- Working deep link: https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/?tool=function-grapher&config=%7B%22functions%22%3A%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22f1%22%2C%22expression%22%3A%224+-+x%5E2%22%2C%22color%22%3A%22%23000000%22%7D%2C%7B%22id%22%3A%22f2%22%2C%22expression%22%3A%22x+%2B+2%22%2C%22color%22%3A%22%232563eb%22%7D%5D%2C%22integrals%22%3A%5B%7B%22functionId1%22%3A%22f1%22%2C%22functionId2%22%3A%22f2%22%2C%22start%22%3A%22-2%22%2C%22end%22%3A%221%22%2C%22color%22%3A%22%233b82f6%22%2C%22opacity%22%3A0.28%7D%5D%2C%22points%22%3A%5B%7B%22x%22%3A-2%2C%22y%22%3A0%2C%22label%22%3A%22%24%28-2%2C+0%29%24%22%7D%2C%7B%22x%22%3A1%2C%22y%22%3A3%2C%22label%22%3A%22%24%281%2C+3%29%24%22%7D%5D%2C%22config%22%3A%7B%22xRange%22%3A%5B-3%2C3%5D%2C%22yRange%22%3A%5B-1%2C5%5D%2C%22majorStep%22%3A%5B1%2C1%5D%2C%22axisLabels%22%3A%5B%22%24x%24%22%2C%22%24y%24%22%5D%7D%7D
- Pre-rendered preview: PNG https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/examples/area-between-curves.png | SVG https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/examples/area-between-curves.svg | Plain-text SVG https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/examples/area-between-curves.svg.txt

## 5. Per-Tool Strict Schemas (Small Files — Safe for Web Fetchers)

Every schema below sets `"additionalProperties": false` and includes one complete verified example and deep link:

- **function-grapher** (Function Grapher): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/function-grapher.json — Plot algebraic/trig/parametric functions, points, vertical asymptotes/lines, tangents, and shaded integrals on a Cartesian plane.
- **inequality-grapher** (Inequality Grapher): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/inequality-grapher.json — Shade 2D linear, nonlinear, or complex loci inequalities and feasible regions.
- **number-line** (Number Line): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/number-line.json — Plot 1D intervals and inequalities with open/closed endpoints and arrows on a number line.
- **box-plots** (Box Plots): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/box-plots.json — Create single or parallel comparative box-and-whisker plots from 5-number summaries or raw data with optional Tukey outliers.
- **histograms** (Histograms): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/histograms.json — Generate frequency histograms from raw numerical data or grouped bin intervals.
- **scatter-plots** (Scatter Plots): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/scatter-plots.json — Plot bivariate (x, y) scatter data with optional linear regression line of best fit and residual views.
- **stem-and-leaf** (Stem & Leaf Plot): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/stem-and-leaf.json — Create ordered single or back-to-back stem-and-leaf plots with split stems, keys, counts, and quartile highlights.
- **visual-quartiles** (Visual Quartiles): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/visual-quartiles.json — Display an ordered list of numbers with visual circle/split annotations showing Q1, Median, and Q3.
- **pie-charts** (Pie Charts): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/pie-charts.json — Create pie or donut charts with percentage/value/combined labels, exploded slices, and legends.
- **segmented-bar-charts** (Segmented Bar Charts): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/segmented-bar-charts.json — Create stacked / percentage segmented bar charts with patterns and legends.
- **bar-charts** (Bar Charts): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/bar-charts.json — Create single-series or grouped column/bar charts with optional value labels and legends.
- **dot-plots** (Dot Plots): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/dot-plots.json — Create statistical dot plots from frequency rows or raw numbers, with optional quartile markers and column totals.
- **frequency-tables** (Frequency Tables): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/frequency-tables.json — Generate clean publication-ready frequency and tally mark tables with optional total row and student worksheet mode.
- **network-grapher** (Network Grapher): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/network-grapher.json — Create weighted/unweighted, directed/undirected graphs & networks from node/edge lists or adjacency matrices with automatic label optimization.
- **venn-diagrams** (Venn Diagrams): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/venn-diagrams.json — Create 1-, 2-, or 3-set Venn diagrams with region counts/probabilities, shading, custom set labels, and optional 2-way companion table.
- **tree-diagrams** (Tree Diagrams): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/tree-diagrams.json — Generate multi-stage probability tree diagrams in bag-draw (with/without replacement) or custom-branch mode.
- **shape-builder** (Shape Builder): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/shape-builder.json — Render 2D, composite, and 3D geometric figures (triangles, quadrilaterals, circles/sectors, L-shapes, prisms, cylinders, cones, spheres, pyramids) with dimension & angle labels.
- **box-builder** (Box Builder): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai/box-builder.json — Render worksheet equations, fractions, and matrices containing fillable answer boxes (\box, \mat).

- Combined strict schema (all 18 tools): https://thebubble333.github.io/GraphMaker02/ai-schema.json

## 7. On-Demand Rendering via GitHub Actions (For AIs with GitHub Access Only)

Repo collaborators (or issues labeled `render` by a collaborator) can trigger `.github/workflows/render-on-demand.yml` via `workflow_dispatch` or by labeling an issue containing a JSON code block `{ "tool": "<slug>", "payload": { ... } }`.
The workflow validates the payload, renders `.png` (300 DPI), `.svg`, and `.svg.txt`, commits them to `public/renders/<tool>-<hash>.*`, and comments back permanent GitHub Pages URLs.

## 8. Other Integration Options

- **Local Desktop MCP Server** (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code): Run `npx tsx mcp/server.ts` locally (`stdio` transport) for `list_math_tools`, `get_tool_schema`, `generate_graph_url`, `render_graph_svg`, and `render_graph_png`. See `AI_MCP_SETUP.md` in the repository.
- **Browser Automation API**: On the live page, `window.GraphMakerAI` exposes `getTools()`, `openTool(slug, payload)`, `exportSVG({ widthCm })`, and `exportPNG({ widthCm, dpi })`.
